annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speakers actively promote purchasing or committing tokens to OneCoin mining while presenting future coin value and mining returns as reasons to participate. They urge viewers to mine immediately, claim that earlier participation will be cheaper and more profitable, and encourage members to bring packages and new miners into the network. The webinar is therefore a solicitation for paid mining and token participation, not merely a neutral technical demonstration.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the presentation links tokens and packages to recurring OneCoin mining output, including automatic mining and preferential mining rates. S06 is separately evidenced by explicit instructions to build a network, sell packages to a downline, and attract new miners. S05 is supported by claims that broader participation will increase the token's value and that OneCoin could reach a stated future value.
